# iPresence 0.0.4
- Added Premium licensing with live lyrics, menu bar customization, and automatic sharing. - Improved onboarding to request Apple Music Automation and macOS Keychain access from the Permissions step. - Added permission status checks when the Permissions step opens and when the app becomes active. - Added handling for revoked Apple Music access, including stopping sharing and reopening the Permissions step. - Added guidance and a System Settings shortcut when Apple Music access has already been denied. - Added a stable bundle identifier and macOS development signing configuration. - Added a Premium promotion page and updated the app website with the $4.99 license price. - Fixed duplicated content across the iPresence website. - Improved lyrics fetching, playback updates, and Premium controls throughout the app.

# iPresence 0.0.3
- Added Premium licensing with live lyrics, menu bar customization, and automatic sharing. - Added onboarding for Apple Music permissions, app setup, and Premium activation. - Added secure license storage and validation through macOS Keychain and Polar. - Added a Premium promotion page and updated the app website with the $4.99 license price. - Improved lyrics fetching, playback updates, and Premium controls throughout the app.
